name: Yatoon Restaurant Menu & Online Ordering
author: yatoon

sections.description:
Yatoon Restaurant Menu & Online Ordering helps restaurants publish a polished menu and accept pay-at-restaurant orders directly from WordPress.

The free version is designed for restaurants that want to receive online orders and collect payment manually at pickup, delivery, or the table. For built-in online payments and advanced customer features, upgrade to Yatoon Menu Pro.

Free Features

  • Beautiful 2-column menu display with photos and categories
  • Category navigation with sticky header
  • Pay-at-restaurant ordering for pickup, delivery, and dine-in
  • Kitchen display screen ([yatoon_kitchen] shortcode)
  • Order status tracking ([yatoon_order_status] shortcode)
  • Email order confirmations
  • Full admin order management
  • Featured items carousel
  • Menu search
  • Built-in customer accounts with order history and favorites
  • Coupons, tax, service fee, delivery fee, and tip support
  • Menu item modifiers, stock control, and availability windows

Pro Features

  • Stripe credit card payments
  • Apple Pay and Google Pay through Stripe
  • Alipay and WeChat Pay through Stripe
  • Stripe webhook payment recovery for safer paid orders
  • SMS verification and SMS order notifications through Twilio
  • Social login with Google, Facebook, and Instagram
  • Premium updates and license management through Freemius

Upgrade to Pro

Yatoon Menu Pro is distributed outside WordPress.org as a separate premium add-on.

  1. Install and use Yatoon Menu Free from WordPress.org.
  2. In WordPress Admin, go to Yatoon Menu → Upgrade to Pro or click Upgrade to Pro on the Plugins page.
  3. Complete checkout through Freemius.
  4. Download the Pro ZIP and license key from Freemius.
  5. Deactivate Yatoon Menu Free.
  6. Upload and activate Yatoon Menu Pro.
  7. Activate your Pro license and configure payment, SMS, and social login settings.

Free and Pro should not be active at the same time.

External Services

The free version works locally for menu browsing and pay-at-restaurant orders. It does not connect to payment providers, SMS providers, or social login providers.

This plugin includes the Freemius SDK for optional licensing, account, and upgrade services. Freemius is only used for opt-in account/license/upgrade workflows in the WordPress admin area.

Freemius service URL: https://freemius.com/
Freemius terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
Freemius privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Pro features can optionally connect to third-party services including Stripe, Twilio, Google, Facebook, Instagram, Alipay, and WeChat Pay. These integrations are opt-in and only used after the store owner configures them.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Yatoon Menu → Settings to configure
  4. Add [yatoon_menu] shortcode to any page
sections.faq:
Does the free version accept credit cards?

No. The free version accepts pay-at-restaurant orders only. Upgrade to Pro for Stripe credit card payments, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Alipay, and WeChat Pay.

Does this plugin work without third-party services?

Yes. Core menu browsing, pay-at-restaurant ordering, kitchen view, and order tracking run inside WordPress without third-party services. Pro integrations are optional.

What shortcodes are available?

  • [yatoon_menu] — Displays the menu and ordering form
  • [yatoon_kitchen] — Kitchen display screen
  • [yatoon_order_status] — Customer order status tracker
sections.changelog:
3.1.0

  • Promoted the free package to 3.1.0 for the current feature and fixes release.
  • Added better front-end account compatibility for logout, account data, and favorites AJAX requests.
  • Kept the newer stock, max-per-order, availability window, and modifiers workflow stable across admin and front end.
  • Improved release metadata so the package version matches the current fixed build.

3.0

  • Major free-version update from the original 2.0.3 release.
  • Added WordPress.org-compliant Upgrade to Pro links, admin upgrade page, and settings-page Pro feature notices.
  • Disabled Pro-only SMS provider settings in the free version and clarified that SMS, payment, and social login integrations are Pro add-on features.
  • Removed remote Google Fonts loading from the free front-end stylesheet.
  • Rebuilt pay-at-restaurant ordering with stronger validation and order storage.
  • Added customer accounts, favorites, order history, and order-again support.
  • Added coupons, modifiers, stock controls, availability windows, fees, tips, kitchen view, and order tracking.
  • Clarified Free vs Pro feature boundaries for payments, SMS, and social login.
  • Added activation protection when another Yatoon Menu Free or Pro package is already active.
  • Made carousel arrows, add buttons, account icon, and cart icon smaller.
  • Strengthened white-background and dark-icon styling to override theme button colors.

2.0.5

  • Updated front-end icon buttons to use white backgrounds with black icons.
  • Replaced colored account and cart emoji with clean black SVG icons.

2.0.4

  • Added activation guard to prevent fatal errors when another Yatoon Menu Free or Pro package is already active.
  • Clarified free vs Pro feature boundaries.

2.0.3

  • Rebuilt checkout flow with full order validation and order storage
  • Added native customer accounts, favorites, and order history
  • Added coupons, modifiers, stock controls, and fulfillment settings

2.0.2

  • Fixed: Moved inline scripts/styles to wp_add_inline_script/wp_add_inline_style
  • Fixed: Added External Services documentation to readme
  • Fixed: Plugin URI updated

2.0.1

  • Fixed: Order placement database error

2.0.0

  • Initial release
